StatelessJdbcListener.selectQuery: SELECT TKEY, TVARCHAR, TBLOB FROM IBISTEMP WHERE TCHAR = '1' AND TNUMBER=${jdbc.statelesslistener.key}
StatelessJdbcListener.afterSelectQuery: UPDATE IBISTEMP SET TCHAR='2' WHERE TKEY=?
StatelessJdbcListener.afterProcessQuery: UPDATE IBISTEMP SET TCHAR='3' WHERE TKEY=?

FixedQuerySender.query: INSERT INTO IBISTEMP(TKEY, TCHAR, TNUMBER, TVARCHAR) VALUES (SEQ_IBISTEMP.NEXTVAL, 'R', ${jdbc.statelesslistener.key}, ?)
